{{Quote|Poor Major Panin died in an Imperial strike on the base a few days ago, killed instantly.|[[Languss Tuno]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Panin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed in [[Aurek Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during [[3642 BBY]], he received orders from [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bevera Dodonna]] to meet with a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] later known as [[Voidhound]], but was killed in an Imperial ambush before the smuggler could arrive. His post was later taken over by [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Kollis]].
